name: Prism Field
tagline: Turn any warehouse into a year-round harvest engine.
positioning: Prism Field is the operating system for indoor growers—orchestrating light, climate, and yield across every rack so small farms grow like giants.

hero.sub: Prism Field unifies every rack, pump, and LED array into one luminous control room—so a two-person farm can run like an industrial harvest without hiring an agronomist.

features.title: Recipe-driven climate
features.description: Dial in light spectrum, humidity, and nutrient dosing per crop, then clone the winning recipe across every tier with one tap. No more sticky-note setpoints.

features.title: Yield forecasting
features.description: See projected harvest weight and sell-by dates before your seedlings emerge, so you can pre-sell to chefs and grocers with confidence.

features.title: Anomaly sentinel
features.description: Prism watches every sensor and pings you the moment a pump stalls or a canopy overheats—hours before the crop notices.

features.title: Rack-level economics
features.description: Track cost-per-gram, energy draw, and margin by shelf. Kill the losing crops and double down on what your buyers reload on.

features.title: Compliance-ready logs
features.description: Every dose, harvest, and cleaning event is timestamped into an audit trail your food-safety inspector will actually thank you for.

features.title: Remote command
features.description: Adjust the entire farm from your phone at 2am. Prism syncs setpoints to your controllers even when the Wi-Fi blinks.

testimonials.quote: We went from guessing to governing. Prism Field caught a failing chiller before it cooked a full basil cycle—that one alert paid for the year.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: I sell to eleven restaurants and used to promise volume I couldn't guarantee. Now I quote from the forecast and never miss a delivery.
testimonials.name: Declan Ross

testimonials.quote: Two people, forty racks, zero clipboards. Prism turned our garage operation into something a distributor takes seriously.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni
